tasks.short: Advise on authenticity and historical customs

steps.what: Establish the client's authenticity question and examine the supplied material
Find relevant passages in the historian's indexed reference collection
Assess provenance, contradictory sources and historical authenticity
Discuss the assessment and its uncertainty with the individual or institution
Write the actual working assessment with source references and limitations
Save the working assessment in the same document store

tasks.design: Configure passage and provenance filters in {DOCS} for the historian's existing reference collection. Keep examination, historical judgment, the advice conversation and the actual working assessment with the historian.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding the right passage required repeated searches across an existing collection.
tasks.enabler_now: Native metadata filters can narrow period, material type and collection without generating historical claims.
tasks.still_hard: A cited parallel does not establish authenticity or resolve a disputed provenance.
tasks.human_edge: The historian weighs material context and explains uncertainty to the client.

ambition.what: No new decision rights; this shortens reference retrieval.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: indexed document metadata can narrow source retrieval; historical authenticity remains an expert assessment.

assumptions: Boundary is an oral consultation that genuinely uses a working assessment record; no additional client report or written send is invented.
The historian maintains title, archive identifier, period and passage links during actual source work; correcting missing metadata is included in s2.
Test native search first. Retrieval already supplied by current configuration earns no new saving. No fabricated source content or clean input feed is assumed.
The integer share1 represents a nearly instantaneous same-system save, fully retained and ungated. Any actual written client delivery needs its own final-version authority and send step.
Shares are unmeasured episode estimates derived from these activities, not the prompt time-share prior.
unknowns: Reference coverage and current native filters
Whether the actual engagement requires a separate written deliverable
research_questions: Can period and material filters retrieve the needed original passages without extra tagging?

already_counted.description: Source checks, assessment, advice and working-record authorship remain in the graph.

incremental.description: Maintain reference filters and check stale links.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R94 gives gross6, less upkeep1 gives net5. Low: disputed materials lack period metadata, so s2 retains18 of20 rather than14; only2 are saved, less1 upkeep gives1. All source judgment and actual record writing remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Interview witnesses and record oral histories

steps.what: Prepare questions and establish the participant's recording choices
Conduct and record the oral-history interview using the recording device
Transcribe the recorded interview into a time-linked working transcript

loop.input: actual recorded audio with speaker segments
loop.output: time-linked transcript with uncertain words marked
loop.check: historian listens against every passage, verifies names and preserves uncertainty
loop.stop: one draft and one correction pass; unclear speech stays marked for manual listening
loop.why_not_simpler: Speech and accents cannot be recovered by field copying.

steps.what: Annotate memory limits, speaker identity and context without changing testimony
Save the restricted working record in its existing store

tasks.design: Use a restricted transcription function for the actual oral-history recording in {OTHER}, the recording and transcription system. Place time-linked draft text in {DOCS}; the historian checks it against audio and adds historical context.
tasks.previous_blocker: Typing a literal transcript consumed time after the actual interview.
tasks.enabler_now: Speech transcription can draft text, with uncertain passages and speaker boundaries exposed for checking.
tasks.still_hard: Accents, overlapping voices, names and fallible memory need careful listening and context.
tasks.human_edge: Trust, follow-up questions and fidelity to the witness's meaning remain human work.

ambition.what: Offer a time-linked working transcript alongside the recording when the participant's scope permits it.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: speech transcription can draft interview text but names, accents and speaker changes need audio checking.

assumptions: This is a genuine recorded and transcribed oral-history episode, not an invented transcript for an informal conversation.
The historian produces the audio and context in s2; preparation and recording choices are counted in s1. Participant time is not claimed as historian saving.
Try the permitted native transcription function first; existing automated transcription earns no new gain. No new external audio disclosure is assumed.
Boundary ends at a restricted working record. Actual archive deposit, consent signature or public release requires its actual authority and separate final-version action; none is hidden in the save.
Save share1 is the schema minimum for near-zero same-system effort, fully retained with no author approval. Episode estimates are unmeasured.
unknowns: Permitted transcription environment and recording choices
research_questions: How much listening remains for the actual speakers and recording quality?

already_counted.description: Preparation, recording, complete audio checking and historical annotation remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain transcription settings and periodically inspect timestamp fidelity.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R89 gives gross11 less upkeep2, net9. Low: overlapping speakers and unfamiliar names require17 of20 transcript hours to remain, rather than9; gross3 less2 upkeep gives1. Recording, contextual annotation and same-system save remain fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Trace historical development in a field

steps.what: Find, read and code actual sources with date, provenance and relevant event references
Assemble dated source references into a sortable chronology and comparison table
Trace historical development by comparing continuities, changes and rival explanations
Write and check the working historical account against original sources and chronology
Save the working account in the same document store

tasks.design: Render the historian's coded notes from {DOCS} into a source-linked chronology using native {SPREADSHEET} sorting or a small deterministic renderer. The historian still chooses evidence, interprets development and checks the written account.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeatedly transferring selected dates and references into chronological order duplicated note-taking.
tasks.enabler_now: Fixed fields and date intervals can produce repeatable linked tables without proposing historical explanations.
tasks.still_hard: Survival bias, changing terminology and uncertain dates can make events incomparable.
tasks.human_edge: Historical causation and source criticism cannot be inferred from the ordering of dates.

ambition.what: Compare a rival periodization against the same source-linked chronology before settling the account.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: fixed dated records can be sorted and rendered with source links; historical interpretation remains expert work.

assumptions: Boundary includes actual source reading, coding, chronology assembly and a working historical account. External publication is a distinct real release if undertaken.
The historian supplies source identifier, passage locator, event label, date or date interval and uncertainty in s1; manual capture and source choice remain fully counted.
Test existing note exports and native table configuration before code. Any chronology already generated has zero new saving; the estimate applies to actual repeated manual assembly.
Do not normalize conflicting calendars or uncertain dates silently. Reject incompatible records for historian handling. Same-system save is minimum share1, retained and ungated.
All shares are unmeasured activity estimates; work shared with an eventual publication must be counted once.
unknowns: Existing note exports and chronology tools
research_questions: Which records need historical dating judgment before they can be sorted?

already_counted.description: Source capture, interpretation and whole-account checking remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain note-field mapping and test date-interval rendering.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R80 gives gross20 less upkeep3, net17. Low: incompatible calendar conventions and uncertain event intervals leave14 of20 assembly hours manual;6 saved less3 upkeep gives3. Source collection, historical reasoning, account writing and checking remain fully retained.

tasks.short: Coordinate workers cataloging and filing historical materials

steps.what: Inspect cataloguing progress and collect workers' actual item status and blockage details
Combine checked item counts and blockage fields into the cataloguing progress view
Assess cataloguing priorities, difficult provenance questions and available capacity
Coordinate cataloguing and filing activities with workers and resolve practical difficulties
Update the actual working coordination record with agreed progress and unresolved issues
Save the working coordination record in the same system

tasks.design: Configure a progress view from checked item status in {OTHER}, the collection catalogue, instead of copying totals into {SPREADSHEET}. Keep prioritization, worker conversations and the actual working coordination record in {PROJECT} with the historian.
tasks.previous_blocker: Manual progress summaries duplicated the status already being checked for coordination.
tasks.enabler_now: Native grouped views can count items by collection, status and blockage code.
tasks.still_hard: A count does not reveal whether a difficult collection item needs specialist judgment or more time.
tasks.human_edge: The historian balances collection priorities and responds to workers' practical difficulties.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: catalogue status fields can support grouped progress views without automating personnel coordination.

assumptions: Boundary is a real progress-coordination episode, including its existing working record, not an invented report after every conversation.

Workers produce actual catalogue records as part of cataloguing, not a new free reporting feed. The historian checks and captures missing collection, item, status and blockage fields in s1; new worker reporting would need separate counted labour.
Test native grouped views first; a view already used earns no new saving. Count only eliminated manual summary assembly.

The working record is neither a formal assignment release nor a catalogue publication. Any actual written assignment issue or external handoff must be its own action with actual final-version authority.
Save1 is minimum integer representation of negligible same-system effort, fully retained without self-approval. Estimates are unmeasured and independent of class and time-share priors.
unknowns: Whether item status is structured enough without extra worker reporting
research_questions: Does the native view expose the actual unresolved items needed for coordination?

already_counted.description: Status capture, priorities, conversations and real coordination-record writing remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain status grouping and check for omitted collections.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R85 gives gross15 less upkeep2, net13. Low: legacy catalogue statuses cannot be grouped consistently, leaving11 of15 summary hours manual;4 saved less2 upkeep gives2. Actual worker coordination, status capture and record writing remain.

role.altitude: Historical judgment and interview relationships stay central; less time goes to literal transcription and repeated table assembly.
reach: Discuss collection metadata compatibility with the archivist; learn catalogue field and date conventions.
role.ambitious_version: A historian who can compare interpretations against traceable evidence while preserving witness voice and historical uncertainty.
